subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report + evidence — intake checklist & sample replies
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@enterprisekind.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@enterprisekind.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request and evidence intake

Hi Kimberly,

We're moving toward contract review for the EnterpriseKind pilot and need your SOC 2 Type II report + a short list of what customers typically share during procurement. Can you confirm:

- Do you have a current Type II report covering the 2025 audit period?
- If not, can you provide a bridge letter or interim statement?
- A short checklist of artifacts we should expect (logs, retention, encryption, policy docs, contact for security questions).

We typically route this to our security and procurement teams — I've CC'd procurement for coordination. Goal is to complete the security checklist by next week (ideally 12/19).

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Head of Cloud Security
EnterpriseKind

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@enterprisekind.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, Procurement <procurement@enterprisekind.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and evidence intake

Elena — thanks for the note and timeline. Quick answers up front:

- We have a SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (issued 2026-06).
- We also provide an optional bridge letter when customers ask for more recent attestation context — template attached.
- Below is a short intake checklist and a set of sample reply snippets you can paste into your tracker.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-typeii-summary-2025.pdf (report summary), redwood-bridge-letter-template.docx, evidence-index.csv

Intake checklist (what customers usually ask for):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — scope and control categories noted at top.
- Bridge letter (if audit period doesn’t cover your required window).
- Evidence inventory / index mapping (CSV) — lists sample artifact names and how to request them.
- Contact for security/ops: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com (security lead).
- Secure transfer options: SFTP, secure Drive link, or encrypted email.

Sample short replies (copy/paste):
1) "We can provide our SOC 2 Type II report covering 2025 (issued June 2026). Please confirm whether you need a bridge letter for coverage through your contract start date."
2) "For artifact delivery we offer: a secure Drive share (preferred), time-limited SFTP, or customer-managed S3 with temporary creds. Let us know which you prefer and we’ll prepare a link."
3) "Primary security contact: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com — please loop him on deeper technical requests or SIG questionnaire follow-ups."

Next steps from our side: we’ll upload the report summary and the bridge letter template to a share link once you confirm preferred transfer method. If you have a SIG/CAIQ, we can start with the basic answers and triage any control-level evidence requests.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Procurement <procurement@enterprisekind.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-13T08:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and evidence intake

Thanks Kimberly — procurement prefers a secure Drive link for documents and a one-page summary for our legal reviewers. Two quick clarifications from security:

- What is the exact audit window covered in the report? (we need start/end dates)
- If you provide a bridge letter, can it explicitly state there were no material control changes since the audit period?

We also use a short SIG-lite questionnaire for initial scoping; if you can return that in line with the items you attached, we can mark the initial pass complete.

—Procurement (on behalf of EnterpriseKind)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@enterprisekind.com>, Procurement <procurement@enterprisekind.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-13T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and evidence intake

Hi Elena / team — looping in briefly from Security. Answers to your clarifying questions:  

- Audit window: 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (testing period). The report was issued by our auditor on 2026-06-15.
- Bridge letter: we can provide a bridge letter that states there were no material control exceptions discovered since the report issuance; the standard wording is included in the attached template. We avoid absolute "no changes" language but will state there have been no material control changes impacting the scope since the audit end date.

Practical note on evidence: to keep procurement cycles quick we recommend starting with the report + bridge letter + the evidence-index.csv. For SIG/CAIQ items that map to system configs (e.g., encryption-at-rest, key rotation), we can provide annotated snippets or redacted logs. If you need full logs or admin-level exports, we’ll want an approved transfer method and a limited scope/timebox.

If helpful, we can also provide two one-line answers for legal review:
- "Redwood Inference holds a SOC 2 Type II report covering 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (issued 2026-06-15)."
- "A bridge letter is available on request; it will describe the coverage window and whether material control changes occurred post-audit."

—Rishi Malhotra
Security Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@enterprisekind.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, Procurement <procurement@enterprisekind.com>
Date: 2026-12-14T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and evidence intake

Thanks all — this is great and moves us forward. Procurement will proceed with the secure Drive link option. Two quick asks before we close the intake:  

1) Please upload the SOC 2 PDF and the bridge-letter draft to the Drive link and share with procurement@example.com; mark the bridge letter as "draft for procurement."
2) Could you also return the SIG-lite answers for the items in the attached CSV (we highlighted ~12 controls we care about)? A short turn (by 12/17) would keep us on track.

If you prefer, use the sample replies Kimberly provided for the legal team — those are perfect. We’ll mark initial pass complete once receipt + SIG-lite answers are in.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Elena
Head of Cloud Security
EnterpriseKind
